title: Social post (X-style)
description: A single public post on an X/Twitter-style microblog, rendered as a timeline screenshot. Keep the text under 280 characters and write it the way a real member of the public would post: informal, emotional, hashtags at the end.

displayName.description: Account display name as shown in bold above the post

verified.description: Show the blue verification badge (news outlets, officials, paid accounts)

avatarStyle.description: Profile picture: photo uses the avatar image slot when one exists, initials draws a colored disc, default draws the grey placeholder silhouette

avatarColor.description: Disc color for the initials avatar

avatarBrief.description: Image-generation brief for the profile photo (used by the media stage, not rendered)
examples: generic angry man in sunglasses, selfie

timestampRel.description: Relative post age exactly as the timeline shows it

replyingTo.description: Handle this post replies to, without @ (shows 'Replying to @…')

text.description: Post text. #hashtags and @mentions are highlighted automatically. Newlines are kept.
examples: NCIA is a joke! Boards say my flight is at Gate A1. I walked to A1 and it's empty. App says A12. Now I'm gonna miss my flight! #Fail #NCIA #Cleveland

attachedImageBrief.description: Image-generation brief for the attached photo (filled into the attached_image slot by the media stage, not rendered as text). Describe a phone photo; never rely on legible text in the image.
examples: phone photo inside the terminal of an empty gate area next to a glowing departures monitor

attachedImageAlt.description: Short description of the attached photo (alt text)
examples: Departures screen next to an empty gate

videoDuration.description: When the attachment is a video, its length as shown on the play badge (M:SS)

metrics.description: Engagement counts under the post. Numbers are abbreviated automatically (12400 → 12.4K).

bookmarks.description: Bookmark count (usually hidden on timelines; shown when > 0)

liked.description: Draw the heart filled (the screenshotting account liked it)
